text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Champions Cup. If she wins 
this race, chances are high that she will 
be nominated as Best Dirt Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All for the sake of winning an award just 
to decline it as a prank, Shinko Windy was 
completely fired up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The crowd watched intently, wondering if 
her strength was genuine. Now was the time 
to show her true power.
